posts.community: Frontier Springs - has departed, whats the next destination?
posts.text: A development in the latest August 2026 investor presentation: A meaningful development this quarter has been our RDSO approval as a developmental vendor for the Failure Indication and Brake Application (FIBA) system. With this approval in place, we have commenced preparations for sample FIBA systems covering 25 coach sets, which will enter a twelve-month trial programme. Subject to successful trials, we expect commercial-scale orders to follow thereafter. The FIBA segment represents a compelling long-term opportunity for the Company.
